verdict.rationale:
jo can 'read existing decks, generate new ones from outlines' (jo-docs-17), showing some presentation-creation capability, but there's no evidence of iterative document editing or of exporting files to standard formats — the closest analog is website publishing (jo-docs-4/5/16), which is not a downloadable/exportable document or presentation.
missing for 10: evidence of general document creation/editing, iterative multi-turn editing of decks/docs, and actual file export/download functionality.
